description: This file contains unit tests for the EntityTag class, verifying its behavior, immutability, parsing logic, validation, and comparison methods within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers.entitytag package.

classes.name: EntityTagTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EntityTag, testing equality, immutability, parsing, validation, and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests that EntityTag correctly implements equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that EntityTag instances are immutable.

methods.name: weakEntityTagFromString
methods.description: Verifies creation and properties of a weak EntityTag from a string, including validity check.

methods.name: strongEntityTagFromString
methods.description: Verifies creation and properties of a strong EntityTag from a string, including validity check.

methods.name: weakPrefixIsCaseSensitive
methods.description: Tests that the 'W/' prefix is case-sensitive and invalid if not uppercase.

methods.name: weakEntityTagMustNotContainAsteriskInOpaqueTag
methods.description: Ensures that weak EntityTags do not contain invalid characters like asterisks in opaque tag.

methods.name: strongEntityTagMustNotContainAsteriskInOpaqueTag
methods.description: Ensures that strong EntityTags do not contain invalid characters like asterisks in opaque tag.

methods.name: weakEntityTagOpaqueTagMustStartWithDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Validates that weak EntityTag opaque tags start with double quotes.

methods.name: strongEntityTagOpaqueTagMustStartWithDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Validates that strong EntityTag opaque tags start with double quotes.

methods.name: weakEntityTagOpaqueTagMustEndWithDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Validates that weak EntityTag opaque tags end with double quotes.

methods.name: strongEntityTagOpaqueTagMustEndWithDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Validates that strong EntityTag opaque tags end with double quotes.

methods.name: weakEntityTagOpaqueTagMustNotContainMoreThanTwoDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Checks that weak EntityTag opaque tags do not contain more than two double quotes.

methods.name: strongEntityTagOpaqueTagMustNotContainMoreThanTwoDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Checks that strong EntityTag opaque tags do not contain more than two double quotes.

methods.name: strongComparisonEvaluatesToFalseForEqualWeakTags
methods.description: Verifies that strong comparison between equal weak tags returns false.

methods.name: strongComparisonEvaluatesToFalseForDifferentWeakTags
methods.description: Verifies that strong comparison between different weak tags returns false.

methods.name: strongComparisonEvaluatesToFalseForOneStrongTagWithSameValueThanWeakTag
methods.description: Verifies that strong comparison between a weak tag and an identical strong tag returns false.

methods.name: strongComparisonEvaluatesToFalseForDifferentStrongTags
methods.description: Verifies that strong comparison between different strong tags returns false.

methods.name: strongComparisonEvaluatesToTrueForEqualStrongTags
methods.description: Verifies that strong comparison between identical strong tags returns true.

methods.name: weakComparisonEvaluatesToTrueForEqualWeakTags
methods.description: Verifies that weak comparison between identical weak tags returns true.

methods.name: weakComparisonEvaluatesToFalseForDifferentWeakTags
methods.description: Verifies that weak comparison between different weak tags returns false.

methods.name: weakComparisonEvaluatesToTrueForOneStrongTagWithSameValueThanWeakTag
methods.description: Verifies that weak comparison between a weak tag and an identical strong tag returns true.

methods.name: weakComparisonEvaluatesToFalseForDifferentStrongTags
methods.description: Verifies that weak comparison between different strong tags returns false.

methods.name: weakComparisonEvaluatesToTrueForEqualStrongTags
methods.description: Verifies that weak comparison between identical strong tags returns true.

methods.name: assertExceptionWhenCreatingFromString
methods.description: Helper method to assert that creating EntityTag from an invalid string throws DittoHeaderInvalidException with the expected message.
